question: Wightman Cup is associated with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Wightman Cup is an annual women's tennis tournament between the United States and Great Britain.**
 
• The tournament was named **after Hazel Wightman, a former US national champion and founder of the Women's Tennis Association.**
 
• The Wightman Cup was first played in **1923 and continued until 1989 when it was replaced by the Federation Cup.**
 
• Golf is associated with the Ryder Cup, Hockey is associated with the Stanley Cup, and Cricket is associated with the Ashes.
 
• Knowing about the history and association of different cups and trophies is important for sports enthusiasts and trivia lovers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ryder Cup is a biennial men's golf competition between teams from Europe and the United States.
 
• The Stanley Cup is awarded annually to the National Hockey League (NHL) playoff champion.
 
• The Ashes is a Test cricket series played between England and Australia.
